name: Nacho Salad
description: A spicy nacho salad with ground beef, lettuce, tomatoes, and nacho chips, topped with a creamy dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese (or mozzarella), shredded

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef with onion and garlic. Drain excess fat.
Add spices and water to the beef mixture. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes. Let cool for 10 minutes.
In a large salad bowl, mix together the shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, shredded cheese, and crushed nacho chips.
In a separate bowl, mix the mayonnaise, relish, ketchup, and hot pepper sauce.
Pour the dressing over the salad and add the cooled meat mixture.
Toss the salad to combine all ingredients and serve.

keywords: nacho salad, spicy salad, ground beef salad

_similar.name: Taco Salad
_similar.description: A hearty taco salad with seasoned ground beef, lettuce, cheese, and crushed taco chips, mixed with Catalina dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1 (250 g) bag cheese taco chips, crushed

recipeInstructions.text: Cook ground beef until crumbly, drain off fat, and season with taco seasoning mix.
Refrigerate the cooked beef until ready to use.
Toss together the cooled beef, chopped lettuce, crushed taco chips, and shredded cheddar cheese.
Mix in Catalina dressing until well coated.
Carefully add in the chopped tomato.
Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: taco salad, ground beef, taco chips, Catalina dressing

_similar.name: Tomato Chickpea Salad
_similar.description: A refreshing salad featuring chickpeas, diced tomatoes, cucumber, and feta cheese, dressed with a tangy vinaigrette.
recipeIngredient: 1 (28 oz) can chickpeas, rinsed and drained

recipeInstructions.text: In a large bowl, combine chickpeas, diced tomatoes, cucumber, green onions, and feta cheese.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, vinegar, garlic, tarragon, parsley, mustard, pepper, and cayenne pepper.
Toss the dressing with the salad ingredients until well coated.
Cover and refrigerate for several hours before serving.

_similar.keywords: chickpea salad, tomato salad, Mediterranean salad, vinaigrette dressing

_similar.name: Cottage Cheese Jellied Salad
_similar.description: A light and fruity salad made with cottage cheese, pineapple, and walnuts, set in a gelatin mold.
recipeIngredient: 3 oz package orange or lemon flavored gelatin

recipeInstructions.text: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add mayonnaise and whisk to blend.
Chill until the mixture starts to set.
Add cottage cheese, pineapple, and walnuts. Combine well.
Pour the mixture into a clear glass bowl or a 4-cup lightly oiled mold.

_similar.keywords: cottage cheese salad, jellied salad, pineapple salad

_similar.name: Tomato Chickpea Salad
_similar.description: A refreshing salad featuring chickpeas, diced tomatoes, cucumber, and crumbled feta, all tossed in a tangy herb-infused dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1 (28 oz) can chickpeas, rinsed and drained
Dressing: 1/3 cup olive oil, 3 Tbsp white wine vinegar, 1 crushed garlic clove, 1 tsp dried tarragon leaves, 1/2 tsp dry mustard, 1/4 tsp pepper, pinch cayenne pepper

recipeInstructions.text: In a large bowl, combine chickpeas, diced tomatoes, cucumber, green onions, and parsley.
In a small bowl, whisk together the dressing ingredients: olive oil, vinegar, garlic, tarragon, mustard, pepper, and cayenne.
Toss the dressing with the salad ingredients until well coated.
Cover and refrigerate for several hours before serving.
